trackazoid

Drop your tracks. Find the next mix.

Keys & help

A / B select a deck · Space play/pause · I / O selection In/Out · L loop selection (or beat loop) · M add marker · 1–8 cue/loop pads · Q Quantize · [ / ] beat jump (Shift moves the loop) · Delete clear selection · Esc pause both.

Empty pads save the selected chunk or active loop; otherwise they save a cue. Filled pads recall it. Shift-click a pad or press Shift+1–8 to clear it. Edit pads to name or replace a saved point or loop. Click the waveform to seek; drag to select, drag its edges to trim, Shift-drag to pan, or Shift-click to extend. Double-click to seek and add a marker; drag a numbered flag to move it. Snap aligns edits to beats; Alt bypasses it. Quantize keeps cue and loop recalls in time while playing. Zoom, Fit and Follow change only the view. Use Loop selection to apply a chunk; clearing the selection keeps the loop playing.

Tempo and beats are detected on load. Press Sync on either deck to match the other, even while paused. Start either deck first. Keep pitch preserves the original pitch; switch it off for pitch that follows tempo. Use Adjust only if the estimate needs correcting. Without a selection, drag active loop edges to trim the loop.

For separate monitoring, choose Split cue and use a DJ splitter cable: master on left, cue on right (both mono). Audio starts off.
